title: rhus rehmanniana var. glabrata
intro: Rhus rehmanniana var. glabrata, commonly known as Chinese sumac, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Anacardiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhus rehmanniana var. glabrata include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant are also responsible for its antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities.
